dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Excuse me, I'm making a video about the environment for the university website. Do you have a minute?
dialogue.reading: ɪkˈskjuːs miː, aɪm ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə ˈvɪdioʊ əˈbaʊt ði ɪnˈvaɪrənmənt fər ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈwɛbsaɪt. duː juː ˈhæv ə ˈmɪnɪt?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: How do you get to the university every day?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ duː juː ˈɡɛt tə ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: By bike. I cycle in order to reduce pollution. And it's good exercise!
dialogue.reading: baɪ ˈbaɪk. aɪ ˈsaɪkəl ɪn ˈɔːrdər tə rɪˈduːs pəˈluːʃən. ənd ɪts ˈɡʊd ˈɛksərsaɪz!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nice. What does your family do to help?
dialogue.reading: ˈnaɪs. ˈwʌt dʌz jʊr ˈfæməli ˈduː tə ˈhɛlp?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Our house uses solar power so that we can save energy and money.
dialogue.reading: aʊr ˈhaʊs ˈjuːzɪz ˈsoʊlər ˈpaʊər soʊ ðæt wiː kən ˈseɪv ˈɛnərdʒi ənd ˈmʌni.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great. And how does your family travel?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. ənd ˈhaʊ dʌz jʊr ˈfæməli ˈtrævəl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: My dad drives an electric car. He bought it in order to save money on fuel.
dialogue.reading: maɪ ˈdæd ˈdraɪvz ən ɪˈlɛktrɪk ˈkɑːr. hiː ˈbɔːt ɪt ɪn ˈɔːrdər tə ˈseɪv ˈmʌni ɑːn ˈfjuːəl.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Do you think everyone should drive an electric car?
dialogue.reading: duː juː ˈθɪŋk ˈɛvriwʌn ʃʊd ˈdraɪv ən ɪˈlɛktrɪk ˈkɑːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not everyone can afford one. I think we need better buses so that people can leave their cars at home.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈɛvriwʌn kən əˈfɔːrd ˈwʌn. aɪ ˈθɪŋk wiː ˈniːd ˈbɛtər ˈbʌsɪz soʊ ðæt ˈpiːpəl kən ˈliːv ðɛr ˈkɑːrz ət ˈhoʊm.
